rules.title: NJ LAD prohibition on source-of-lawful-income housing discrimination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not discriminate in housing based on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent payment a tenant uses. For example, a landlord cannot deny a Section 8 voucher holder an apartment based solely on that source of income.

exemption_conditions.condition: Rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family dwelling where the other unit is occupied by the owner as his/her residence at the time of rental
Rental of a room or rooms by the owner or occupant of a one-family dwelling occupied by him/her as his/her residence at the time of rental
Preference given to persons of the same religion by a religious organization in the sale, lease or rental of real property

coverage.notes: Applies to the sale or rental of all property, including open land, for business or residential purposes. The owner-occupied exemptions cover a two-family dwelling (one unit rented) or room rentals in a one-family dwelling.

rules.coverage_text: The LAD applies to the sale or rental of all property, including open land, whether used for business or residential purposes, subject to the listed exceptions.
rules.exemptions: Exempt: rental of one apartment in a two-family dwelling when the owner lives in the other unit; rental of rooms in a one-family dwelling occupied by the owner or occupant as a residence; and a religious organization's preference for persons of the same religion.
rules.quoted_span:
The LAD also prohibits housing discrimination  based
on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent
or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses.

llm.notes: This is a Division on Civil Rights brochure about the NJ Law Against Discrimination. Only the source-of-lawful-income provision was recorded, under screening_restrictions. The general protected-class prohibitions and the service-animal fee and modification rules are general anti-discrimination provisions, so they were not recorded. The text gives no section citation for the source-of-income provision.
